verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own documented bulk capability is migration: the WorkOS CLI migrations tool exports Auth0 data and the AuthKit API imports users, organizations, memberships, roles and SSO connections as a package. Audit Log Events can also be exported in bulk. There is no evidence of general-purpose bulk update or delete endpoints or batch actions on existing items; pagination helpers and the MCP server are only building blocks. Missing for 10: general batch/bulk mutation APIs for existing users, organizations or roles, bulk operations via the MCP server or dashboard, documentation of batch limits, and independent hands-on corroboration.
